instruction: In GIMP, load 'character.png' from the desktop, enhance its color saturation, then save the edited image as 'character_vibrant.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, increasing color saturation, and saving as character_vibrant.png. Evaluator uses a custom wrapper function check_saturation_increase_and_structure_sim__e8172110 that adapts the existing check_saturation_increase_and_structure_sim metric to work with rule-based expected format. The wrapper retrieves the original image from cache and verifies: (1) the result image has higher saturation than the original, and (2) the structure is preserved (hue and value channels remain similar).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if saturation increased and structure preserved, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves the result file (character_vibrant.png) from VM using vm_file getter
Expected configuration correctly references the original image (character.png) from cache using rule type
Wrapper metric function correctly extracts cache_file from rules dict and constructs the original image path
Underlying metric check_saturation_increase_and_structure_sim correctly verifies saturation increase: checks that result saturation > original saturation
Metric correctly verifies structure preservation by comparing hue and value channels using SSIM
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both requirements from instruction (saturation increase + save with correct filename)
Logic flow is correct: result_path (vibrant) passed as src, original_path passed as tgt, metric checks src_saturation > tgt_saturation
